Harper (People Ops): Quick note: All-hands next Wed 11am PT (HQ + Zoom). Short agenda and two asks below. Drop Qs here or use the form (anon): https://forms.redwood.internal/ah-qna.

Harper (People Ops): Agenda (22m):
• 7m — Company snapshot & priorities (Zoe)
• 6m — Playbook launch highlights + checklist (Arjun)
• 4m — Runtime perf update + rollout plan (Marta)
• 3m — Security note: retention & key rotation (Drew)
• 2m — GTM partner shout & renewals primer (Nia)
• 0-?m — Rapid Q&A (may run a few extra minutes)

Harper (People Ops): Asks: 1) Upload slides to drive.redwood.internal/allhands/wed-2026 by Tue 3pm. 2) If you need a breakout demo room, reply with size.

Zoe (CEO): I'll open with a quick runway/metrics snapshot and one ask for leaders: call out any cross-team risks.

Arjun (Product): We'll run through the launch playbook and a short readiness checklist. Requesting 2 slides. Will paste the playbook link in chat during the call.

Marta (Eng): Eng wants to show a 30s clip of the KV-prefetch perf gain (~13% p99). Need co-host for demo.

Drew (Security): Heads-up: we'll briefly announce scheduled key rotation and a small internal logs retention change. No change to customer defaults. I'll share a scoped brief.

Nia (GTM): We'll call out the new partner launch for 20s and post a renewals FAQ draft for CSMs. Tagging RevOps for numbers.

Event Bot: Calendar updated: "All-Hands — Playbook & Ops" Wed 11:00 PT — Zoom link pinned.

Harper (People Ops): Recording will be posted to #all-hands-recordings within 24h. If you want clips, DM with timestamps. Please confirm slide upload here once done. Thanks :sparkles:
